title: CI runner label in workflow matrices and cache keys: change the runner string in every if-condition and cache key together
answers: After changing the runner, why did lint steps like the pre-commit hook or problem matchers silently stop running?
How are the mypy, install-bin and pre-commit caches keyed in the copilot setup workflow?
Which workflow conditions compare against the runner name in the lint matrix?
What do I need to update when I rename the OS in a CI matrix?
body:
Path: .github/workflows/lint.yml (strategy.matrix.os, job `name` expression, and the `if:` gates on problem matchers, function signature, whitespace and uv.lock checks) and .github/workflows/copilot-setup-steps.yml (actions/cache keys `mypy-`, `install-bin-` and `pre-commit-` prefixes).
Rule: The runner string appears in three places that must change together: the matrix value, the equality comparisons `matrix.os == '<runner>'` used to gate Linux-only steps and the job name, and cache key and restore-key prefixes that embed the runner name (e.g. `mypy-ubuntu-24.04-`). Changing only the `runs-on` line leaves the Linux-only gates false and the caches keyed on the old name.
Symptom: After the runner was pinned, Linux-only lint steps would be skipped if a comparison still referenced the old label; the PR updated the comparisons and cache prefixes to `ubuntu-24.04` to keep them running.
Constraints: Keep macOS matrix entries (`macos-latest`) and their `lint-macos` naming as-is. Check each `if:` referencing `matrix.os` after any runner rename.
applies: Editing runner labels, matrix OS values or cache keys in MLflow GitHub Actions workflows.
says: Code formatting and lint checks silently stopped executing during automated pull request validation.
Build caches are missing and causing slower test runs after updating build machine names.
Make sure conditional verification steps still trigger when updating the build operating system matrix.
Why were whitespace checks and automated quality gates bypassed on our Linux test jobs?
Ensure Mac validation jobs remain untouched while adjusting Linux build matrix configurations.
search: CI workflow runner updates require synchronizing the runner string across matrix values, conditional if-comparisons, and cache key prefixes in .github/workflows/lint.yml and .github/workflows/copilot-setup-steps.yml. Updating only runs-on leaves matrix.os equality gates false and caches keyed to the old runner name, silently skipping Linux-only steps such as problem matchers, function signature, whitespace, and uv.lock checks. Applies when modifying runner labels, matrix OS values, or actions/cache prefixes (mypy-, install-bin-, pre-commit-) in MLflow workflows. Requires checking every if-condition referencing matrix.os while preserving macOS matrix entries (macos-latest) and lint-macos job naming.
